old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a white ceramic mug placed on a wooden surface. Initially, a stream of dark brown liquid, presumably coffee, is poured into the mug from above. As the liquid fills the mug, it creates ripples and bubbles on the surface. The pouring action ceases, and the liquid settles before the sequence ends. The background is blurred and dark, showing an indistinct setting. There are no visible characters or animals in the scene.

The pouring action continues until the mug is nearly full. The background is blurred, showing an outdoor setting with what appears to be a garden or natural environment. caption: The video captures a white ceramic mug with a left handle on a light wooden surface against a dark, blurred background, partly filled with coffee. A stream of coffee is already falling from above into the right side of the mug, striking the surface and churning up foam and ripples. As the excerpt progresses, the stream steadily thins to a narrow trickle before vanishing, leaving only disturbed liquid and rising steam. A brief, fine trickle then reappears over the center, ending in a small splash, after which no further pouring is visible. The foam band from the pour gradually settles into a small cluster of pale bubbles along the far rim. The mug stays fixed throughout, with no translation or camera movement. Faint steam continues to drift from the dark surface as the liquid calms.
